why: Grown-ups / family: desi comedy skits in Urdu. Animated comedy skits are one of the strongest Shorts formats, and everyday Pakistani humour is very shareable on WhatsApp and Facebook.

series.name: Chacha Jee aur Pappu
series.style: 3D animated comedy film look, bright Pakistani home, street, bazaar and wedding settings, expressive faces, warm sunny colours, vertical 9:16 frame
series.negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blood, violence, insulting stereotypes, blurry

characters.name: Chacha Jee
characters.look: Chacha Jee, a round-bellied Pakistani uncle in his fifties with a big black moustache, a grey karakul cap, a white shalwar kameez and a grey waistcoat

characters.name: Pappu
characters.look: Pappu, his clever 12-year-old nephew with spiky black hair, a green cricket t-shirt and jeans

characters.name: Chachi Jaan
characters.look: Chachi Jaan, a sharp but kind Pakistani aunt in a maroon shalwar kameez with a printed dupatta over her shoulders

rules: Family-friendly desi comedy. Laugh with the characters, never at any ethnicity, religion, region or group.
Chacha Jee is confident and always sure he knows best; Pappu is smart and patient; Chachi Jaan always wins in the end.
Each episode is one everyday situation that builds to a funny twist punchline in the last two shots.
Narration in natural spoken Urdu, in Urdu script. Short, punchy lines.
The last shot is the punchline, then a quick tease of the next situation.
